cd /workspace && timeout 300 python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import ref, gen
K=64; c=list(range(1,K+1))
ring=[c[s:]+c[:s] for s in range(K)]
chords=[]
for i in range(1, K-1):
    chords.append([i, i+2, i+1])
    chords.append([i+1, i, i+2])
paths = ring + chords
agg=ref.aggregate([(tuple(p),1) for p in paths], set())
_l,_r,final=ref.peel_naive(agg)
cl=sorted({ref.canon(p[i],p[i+1]) for p in final for i in range(len(p)-1)})
print('links', len(cl), 'final paths', len(final))
o=gen.find_order(cl, final, random.Random(3), tries=100)
print('order', 'None' if o is None else 'ok (%d)' % len(o))
EOF
